sql:
SELECT
    psc.ProductSubcategoryName AS SubcategoryName,
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate) AS AvailableForSaleDate,
    minIf(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate), 1) AS FirstIntroInSubcategory,
    CASE WHEN toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate) = min(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) OVER (PARTITION BY psc.ProductSubcategoryKey) THEN 'First/Existing' ELSE 'New Introduction' END AS ProductStatus,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DateKey <  addMonths(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate), 0)) AS SalesBeforeNewIntro_Placeholder,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DateKey <  addMonths((min(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) OVER (PARTITION BY psc.ProductSubcategoryKey)), 6)) AS SalesFirst6MonthsOfSubcategory,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, fs.DateKey >= addMonths((min(toDate(p.AvailableForSaleDate)) OVER (PARTITION BY psc.ProductSubcategoryKey)), 6)) AS SalesAfterNewIntroWindow,
    countDistinct(fs.DateKey) AS ActiveSalesDays
FROM retail.DimProduct AS p
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN retail.FactSales AS fs ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE p.AvailableForSaleDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    psc.ProductSubcategoryKey,
    psc.ProductSubcategoryName,
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    p.AvailableForSaleDate
ORDER BY
    SubcategoryName ASC,
    AvailableForSaleDate ASC
